# EhOsContract.Contract

The Spark extension behind `use EhOsContract.Contract`.

One top-level section, so every entity is written straight into the module body:
the units that decide (aggregates and dynamic consistency boundaries) with their
state, invariants, commands, events and stage groups; what reacts to events
(policies, effects, process managers); what is read (read models, queries); what
enters from elsewhere (`consumes` from a sibling contract, `subscribe` from another
application) and what leaves the application (`publish`);
the process, when it describes one; and scenarios. The vocabulary is closed: a contract cannot add
extensions.

Options may stand beside a `do` block (`EhOsContract.DslWrappers`).

The structs this module defines are what Spark builds from each declaration. They stay inside the
extension: readers get plain data from `EhOsContract.Model`, never these structs.

## contract

At most one process, and everything born in the contract.



| Entity | What it declares |
|--------|------------------|
| [`aggregate`](contract-aggregate.md) | A unit that decides over one stream, identified by its identity. |
| [`dcb`](contract-dcb.md) | A dynamic consistency boundary: a unit that decides over the events it consults. |
| [`policy`](contract-policy.md) | Whenever an event happens, issue a command. |
| [`effect`](contract-effect.md) | A side effect on an event, outside the log. |
| [`process_manager`](contract-process_manager.md) | Steers a run: starts on an event, reacts, sets timers, ends. |
| [`read_model`](contract-read_model.md) | Rows projected from events, for queries to read. |
| [`query`](contract-query.md) | A question an actor may ask of a read model; a capability, like a command. |
| [`domain_service`](contract-domain_service.md) | Domain logic that belongs to no unit (ESDM's domain service): pure functions a decision calls through the module the contract generates, which holds them to their types. |
| [`consumes`](contract-consumes.md) | A sibling contract's events, read from this log. |
| [`subscribe`](contract-subscribe.md) | Another application's published event, taken into an inbox by a policy, with the fields this contract reads. |
| [`publish`](contract-publish.md) | An integration event: the one way an event leaves the application. |
| [`process`](contract-process.md) | The process the contract describes, if any, at most one: its runs, stages and promises. |
| [`scenario`](contract-scenario.md) | Given events, a trigger, and what follows: an example the process owner reads. |
